frozen: Master, Gaussian IDs, Anchor owners/centers/scales, cameras, eligibility and cached uniforms
trainable: original Selector and encoder plus compensation head and four independent per-Anchor ratio latent tables; direct compensation does not consume h or send gradient through encoder
initialization: same seed and initial output p=.5/delta=0; encoder/Selector/compensation second layer and output exact equal; first3 raw columns and first8 latent projection columns match across direct variants
loss: unchanged photo 0.8L1+0.2(1-fast_ssim), plus original .01 relative expected-budget L1
selection: unchanged cached Bernoulli training; evaluate same-K logit(p)-logit(cached uniform) and original cached policy separately
unseen: raw-ratio linear interpolation of Anchor compensation latent, then same head; no fitting at unseen ratios
evaluation: final12000 only, 13 internal-Bank holdout and historical45 nonBank, all4 metrics, per-view and per-ratio
scope: quick single-seed frozen-map diagnostic, not stable improvement or pure compression causal proof; encoder gradient routing and effective depth also differ
